title: The Lumen Garden
theme: A glowing crystal garden defends against creeping dusk-mist that flows along a winding path toward the heart crystal.
mechanics: Place lumen crystal towers on grass tiles beside the path to auto-disperse nearby dusk-mist
Three tower types — Crystal (direct damage), Prism (area dispersion), Beacon (slow plus damage)
Survive eight hand-authored waves of mist of increasing size and toughness
Earn light from dispersed mist to buy more towers
Protect the heart crystal — mist reaching the end costs a life; clear the final wave to win

controls.action: Place the selected tower on a grass tile
Start the next wave of mist
